== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on English [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber]] and [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (PC Errata)]]. Glossary 2.0 replacement; Appendix A matches, so there is no second PC column. Do not mix [[Jedi Lightsaber]]. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
